svg.text: The large-D chain: the errors in Δ and the condition of its solve
Top: measured differences in Δ and the uncertainty each source states. Bottom: the largest over the smallest pivot of the chain's Jacobian at each base.
The two panels share the D axis. An error in Δ and a condition number have no common unit, so each has its own vertical axis.
error or difference in Δ (lower is better)
bias removed by the held fit
the smallest pivot starts to fall
D 215.03, where the chain had stopped
chain run on win2, Intel Core Ultra 7 265K, 18 threads
